contracts.docstring: Typed exploratory content only; project, task, author and permissions come from the live native grant.
Persist typed scope/area evidence and ordinary Markdown report in one fenced receipt transaction, without accepting work.
Handles task_rejected events -> rework by the assigned developer/researcher.
Return an owner hint for migrated/native work before any legacy claim or inference.
Handles review_ready events -> CodeReviewFlow or research peer review.
Return an owner hint for migrated/native work before any legacy claim or inference.
Atomically claim a task for review. Returns True if this agent won.
Reject owner-managed tasks before atomically recording a remaining legacy reviewer.

Handles task_available and task_resume events.

Dispatches to DevelopmentFlow or ResearchFlow based on task type.
Acknowledge owner-managed task hints without claiming them; dispatch remaining legacy tasks.
Look up the task type from the DB.
Read only the requested task inside its actual project.
Atomically claim a task.
Check ownership and claim eligible legacy work under the same write lock.
Scan for orphan tasks and create missing agent_events.
Find legacy candidates only; native-owned work is not a missing legacy event.
Filter scoped query candidates against the actual native ownership boundary.
Load the requested historical export only, preserving its original class/module identity.
Keep the old kickoff entry as a read-only bridge to explicit native admission.
Retain a compatibility state object without initializing a legacy flow engine.
Validate actual project/task scope and return existing native references or the owner admission action.
Orchestrates the complete project lifecycle using event-driven flows.

Launch up to max_concurrent_tasks sub-flows and wait for any to finish.

Returns "native_owner_required", "no_pending_tasks" or "task_completed"; an owner handoff ends dispatch without evaluating project completion.
Run a sub-flow in a background thread and signal completion.
Check if a task is still in a running state.
Verify selected report bytes and original writer intent before attributing its delivery.
Capture only selected complete reports and their exact finding/source dependencies within a byte bound.
Inspect an observed subject and page actual review attempts without auto-validation.
Own an immutable original execution and explicit owner graph revisions; author results still require independent review and owner acceptance.
Capture current accepted plan, original repository and exact node contexts/edges, excluding operational status so accepting a result does not change the intent.
Freeze one ready original delivery before admission; unfinished dependencies and attempted deliveries stay pending/history without replay.
Return a detached validated append-only plan; quotes must exist in attributed material, and every dependency must stay inside its DAG.
Supported task outcome, acceptance criteria and local prerequisites; no actor/claim/permission can be model selected.
Group actual finding references by an explicit area; an empty reference list identifies an unresolved area rather than fabricated evidence.
One bounded Scope/Gather/Organize/Summarize output; the author states limits and next steps without accepting work or grading scientific confidence.
Validate actual report constraints and full retained size before any write; never trim evidence silently.
Produce canonical Markdown and exact linked findings from the same typed summary used for provenance; no secondary synthesis model runs.
Atomically write the scoped typed summary, canonical report and one original receipt under the live native investigation author's grant.
Keep report/metadata/receipt in the same owner transaction; a missing artifact cannot become a delivered result.
Bind typed scope and canonical report to the actual original author operation; metadata words alone cannot label an arbitrary draft as an investigation result.
Own scoped source/finding/report/wiki transactions, revocable grants and atomic effect receipts.
Bind each supported mutation to its explicit stored grant capability.
Insert canonical draft/evidence rows inside the caller's already-authorized receipt transaction; shared by ordinary and exploratory reports.
Persist an ordinary canonical report and its exact original writer receipt under the current scoped grant.
Persist a typed exploratory scope/area summary through the same report and receipt transaction, never a task acceptance.
One canonical signature/schema and HTTP mapping for either transport.
Translate host-owned business tools to scoped HTTP without owning grants or inference.

Persist one scoped exploratory report: question, included/excluded scope, observations grouped by area and exact finding IDs, conclusion, limits and proposed next steps. Unresolved areas may have no findings; the complete report needs cited evidence. This is a draft, not scientific confidence, owner acceptance or permission to execute next steps. Reuse operation_key after an uncertain reply.
Return an owner hint for migrated/native-owned tasks, or None for remaining legacy work; reject missing and foreign task scope.
Resolve a legacy event in its project, without selecting agents or changing task state.
Refuse legacy mutation/inference for migrated exploratory work and any task with native admission history.
Build subscription-only sessions with required Ken and host-owned private development views.
Admit one original project attempt with required Ken and revocable peers.
Own native attempts and grant-bound tool closure before durable terminal states.
Schedule an admitted run once after checking its binding and execution profile.
Own one admitted native turn, then prove peer/tool closure before finalizing it.
Own durable admission, fenced attempts and version-bound review requests in SQLite.
Atomically freeze host input and reserve its one non-replayable turn.
Advance controlled author or reviewer generation while using the real admitted tool bridge.
Normal startup installs the typed publication schema, keeps accepted provenance and prevents retargeting its immutable original request.
Create one actual bound author and captured evidence under an explicitly admitted exploratory task.
Describe one supported documentary observation and an unresolved area without fabricating another finding.
One structured summary preserves scope, grouped evidence and unknowns in report/result snapshots; only the existing owner decision completes the task.
An investigation cannot masquerade as a typed scoped result by selecting an ordinary free-text report.
The actual old flow/event entry now exposes owner admission, retaining historical reports and leaving task/result state unchanged.
Current legacy tools and raw legacy completion/claim statements cannot turn an unadmitted investigation into running or accepted work.
Queued review/rejection messages cannot claim an investigator or create an automatic native review.
A documentary handoff must not be rediscovered as missing legacy work indefinitely.
Only-native pending work returns a distinct handoff route; it must not re-enter legacy progress inference or call the project complete.
Retry changes, foreign evidence and metadata overwrites cannot manufacture a different original exploratory result.
The ordinary exact-subject review can inspect an exploratory summary without changing confidence, accepting the result or completing the task.
A failed schema52 install rolls back its table/guards; a repeatable successful upgrade preserves actual schema51 historical records.
Prepare exactly schema51 without changing any historical migration resource.
One original owner execution sends three native turns total: planner, researcher and developer; only owner-accepted research wakes its dependent and no code is accepted or published.
A failed migration cannot leave rebuilt half-tables; upgrading an actual schema49 preserves original identities and exact handoff bytes.
Prepare the real pre-upgrade schema without modifying its historical SQL resources.
A failed schema51 install cannot change existing manifests or replace the old invalidation view; successful retry retains exact original intent and foreign keys.
Prepare the actual schema50 while leaving its historical SQL resources unchanged.

Run pending schema migrations for existing databases.

Checks the ``schema_migrations`` table and applies any missing
migrations. Safe to call multiple times. Serving requires an already
initialized file; explicit installation/legacy callers may create one.
Identify the task within the tool's already-bound project.
Claim remaining legacy tasks or return a read-only native owner hint.
Scope every read/claim to the bound project and never claim owner-managed work.
Resolve the owner boundary and claim remaining work in one write transaction.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. Relevant new frontend modules and exported helpers also carry English JSDoc; no claim that all historic project definitions are documented.
